answer: Each epoch the beacon derives a nonce from the agent key and epoch seed; every answer solves a hash puzzle bound to that nonce, so clones can't copy identical work — each computes its own. Each agent locks a 120 POA pearl bond; a nonce-solution matching another's is deduped into a karst drain, slashed half burned, half paid to a 40 POA bounty catcher. Valid solutions ripple the nonce to next epoch. One thousand sybils lock 120,000 POA for one thousand nonce computations; each repeated nonce costs 60 POA plus bounty. A cloned answer is a counterfeit pearl: same look, different grain.
